notes: Environment variables override these values: AI_PROVIDER, AI_MODEL, AI_BASE_URL, AI_EFFORT, AI_MIN_INTERVAL_MS. Article text is passed as escaped data inside <article> tags and the system prompt tells the model to treat it as data, not instructions.

gemini.description: Google Gemini API (free tier available) through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint

openai_compatible.description: Any other OpenAI-compatible API, e.g. Groq (https://api.groq.com/openai/v1) or OpenRouter (https://openrouter.ai/api/v1). Set AI_BASE_URL and AI_MODEL.
